o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish پنبوق (pambuq). Cognate with Middle Persian pmbk'. Possibly related to Ancient Greek βάμβαξ (bámbax).
From Ottoman Turkish مطبعه (matbaʼa), equivalent to Arabic مَطْبَعَة (maṭbaʕa), from Arabic طَبَعَ (ṭabaʕa).
From Persian بد نعل. By surface analysis, bəd- + nal.
